Equipment:
 Distance Relay 
 MICOM P437
 AREVA T&D

The distance protection device P437 is used for selective short circuit 
protection, ground fault protection, and overload protection in 
extra-high-voltage systems. The system can be operated as impedance-grounded or 
isolated-neutral systems.

All kinds of faults are detected including close-in three-phase; cross-country 
faults, evolving faults and high-resistance earth faults

This procedure details the steps required to completely check the proper 
operation and calibration of the relay. It is recommended this procedure to be 
carried out on an annually bases. The document is formatted the way to minimize 
the possibility of error causing personal injury or damage to equipment.

The first is initiated by eng. Abd 
El-Sattar Khalifa, tested by eng. Sidhom Nassef & eng. El-Sayed Edris, 
revised by eng.Adel El-Naggar: MDEPC quality control engineer, accepted by eng. Aly Zahran: 
 general manager & eng. Samir Abdel-Gilil: quality control general 
 director, approved by eng. Ahmad Sawan: head sector of Nubaria PS, and certified by eng. Mohamed Naguib: 
MDEPC
quality control head sector

Wear 
 your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.

items: A work permit must be issued.
The maintenance staff should be trained, qualified, and carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Line isolation is required.

Make sure that CT secondary circuits are shorted before isolating the 
 current circuits for test distance protection.
Transmission Line must be grounded.
ISA DRTS tester.
Test leads.

PC laptop with necessary software {ISAWIZARD and 
Micom S1-13- P437}
Tools bag.

Make sure CT secondary circuits are shorted at the incoming terminal blocks 
 before isolate the relay current circuits for test.

Be sure that the DC power of the relay is correct by applying DC voltmeter 
 across points (25,26 see fig.1) on the rear of the relay

items: Connect the personal computer to the ISA tester.
Be sure that ISA tester is connected to EARTH.
Switch ON ISA tester.

After ISA tester completely in service connect Currents, Voltages and binary 
 input leads between ISA tester and test plug (X21-1 & X21-2) see figure 2) for
 Micom P437.
Make short between points (X21-1 13 &14) and points (X21-1 15 & 6 ) see figure 3
Run ISA Wizard software and design RIO file for P437 characteristic.
NOW you can choose two ways to test this relay.
Note: Don't forget to GENERATE PREFAULT CONDITION [I=0.001A, V=57V].

From TEST SELECTION chose automatic time zone (Z/T) and dont forget to 
 adjust the test sequence as follow [fault = all faults, Z min = zero, Z max 
 = as the setting, STEP =0.5 OHM, Angle [degree] = 0, after that click OK the 
 tester will operate and test the R axis.
Repeat step 9, BUT choose angle = 90 the tester will test the X axis.
Choose STORE ALL TESTS >>>>.

Go to RESULTS from main menu choose HEADER and apply all information about 
 this FEEDER and OK
Now print the results and you have complete test results for this relay.

From TEST SELECTION, choose Click and test and by curser click on the point 
 which you need to test [generally choose all points on X and Y Axis].
Repeat steps from 11 to 13.
Now you have complete test results for this relay.

From main menu select TEST SELECTION select
 POWER SWING test and plot the setting.
Click Start
Chose STORE ALL TESTS

Go to RESULTS from main menu choose HEADER and apply all information about this

Now print the results and you have complete test results for this function.

 setting from Rio file.
Make prefault at zero current and voltage
Click ok.
Inject current and voltage as fault case in any zone Z2 or Z3
Click Start.

Choose STORE ALL TESTS, from results will see that the time at all 
 faults is equal to Z1 time.
From results will see that the time at all faults is equal Z1 time.

RUN ISA WIZARD software and choose GENERATION AND DISTRIBUTION RELAYS>>>> X-PRO

GENERATE PREFAULT CONDITION [I=0.001A, V=57V].
Disable distance functions.

SELECT FAULT AND INJECT CURRENT VALUE EQUAL TO (I Setting*1.01) to determine 
 the operating time
Click Start.
Repeat steps from 1 to 5 for all phases R, S, and T.

sections.text:
Return 
Relay and Associated Equipment to Service

items: Enable any function which was disabled.

Return relay to service by removing the test leads from the relay terminals 
 and the test set.
Make sure CT and VT secondary circuits are in normal condition.
Remove the disturbance alarm LED's on the relay which is caused by the test.
Request feeder to be returned in service

Take pharos readings of all AC currents and voltages and compare them to those 
 for normal load condition.

Check that these reading agree with station meters (MW, 
 Mvar, Amperes and 
 power factor).
Place a copy of the test result in the field maintenance file.
